TARGETING

This unit goes through each item on the lists RedX and RedY (which represent the position of each Red unit)

It then uses the distance formula to calculate which enemy is the closest. Distance formula --- sqrt((x1 - x2) * (y1 - y2))

This script can be edited to find the enemy with the most HP, farthest enemy, etc.

DODGE

Dodge is sort of an "armor" system. The more dodge a unit has, the more enemy units will miss when trying to shoot this unit.

When a unit shoots, their % chance of missing = their miss chance + unit dodge. A dodge of 100, for example, will mean that everyone's shots will miss against this unit.
